_comment: Line hit testing under Albers. The line is drawn with line-width 24, so its stroke reaches y=197 at this column, but queryRenderedFeatures still hits at y=200. That overshoot is inherited from gl-js: the half-width is converted with pixelToTileUnitsFactor (style/query_geometry.ts:268), which is the Mercator pixels-per-tile-unit ratio, while the geometry it is compared against is in Albers-reprojected tile space. The query region is therefore ~1.6x the drawn stroke here. This test pins that behaviour so native and gl-js stay in step; see the Mercator control, where the query boundary does coincide with the stroke.
